source.name: MLB.com press release
source.quote: The Seattle Mariners and T-Mobile (NASDAQ: TMUS) today announced that the home field of the Mariners will be known as T-Mobile Park for the next 25 years.

note: Arena naming rights: T-Mobile Park. Start date unknown: the record said 2026 (the season it was recorded), its source is from 2018-12-19.
